en.4: Tajweed in lingustics: Enhancement. In applied definition: A science is established to give every letter its right and due from the articulation point and characteristic,when stopping or starting with no exaggration or intensiveness. - Its right: inherent, permanent and constant characteristics that cannot be removed from the letter like Jahr (appearence) and Shiddah (Strength). - Its due: Temporary characteristics are caused by permanent characteristics like Idgham (merging), ikhfaa (hiding) and Ithhar (clarity).... etc. Theoretical aspect: To recognize the rules, regulations and conditions of tajweed. Its rule: Fard Kfayah (Collective duty). Practical aspect: To apply theoretical rules of tajweed during the recitation of the Qur'an. Its rule: Fard Ain ( an individual duty). To keep your tongue from committing mistakes (Lahn) when reciting the Qur'an. To get Allah's pleasure. Its definition Its rule Its advantage and benefit Definition of the science of Tajweed

en.6: Lahn in lingustics: keeping away from right, It is said (lahana) if he committed Mistake. In applied definition: committing Mistakes when reciting the Qur'an and deviating from correctness. Lahn (Mistake) is divided into two types: (Lahn Jali and Lahn khafi) (Obvious Mistake and Hidden Mistake). It is a mistake that occurs to the word, causing its makeup to be disturbed whether the meaning is changed or not. It is called (jali) obvious because it is a clear defect that all Qur'an scholars and others know. It is haram (forbidden) and the reciter is punished when he makes this mistake intentionally or neglects learning although he can do this. en.11: There are 4 correct and permissible ways of linking ist'adhah with basmalah with the beginning of the surah except surat A'tawbah (Bara'ah). The first way: cutting off all of them: He stops on ist'adhah and basmalah with taking breath. The second way: Joining ist'adhah with basmalah and stopping on it with taking breath. Then, starting with the surah. The third way: Stopping on ist'adhah and then, joining basmalah with the beginning of the surah. The fourth way: joining all of them: With no stopping. If the reciter began from within the surah (The middle of the surah) which means after the beginning even if it is after one word, the reciter has the choice to say basmalah or not,but saying it is better. If the reciter chose to say basmalah, he will join it with ist'adhah by the previous four ways with the beginning of the surah. If he chose not to say basmalah, he will have two ways: The first way: Qat' (Cutting off): Stopping on ist'adhah and cutting it off the next verses. The second way: Wasl (Joining):Joining ist'adhah with the next verses. en.15: The Holy Qur'an consists of( surahs) chapters, the chapters consist of verses (Ayat), the verses consist of words and every word consists of letters so, the smallest unit of the Qur'an is the letter. The letter: a sound depends on specific or approximate articulation point, The letter may be sakin or voweled (with fathah, dammah or kasrah). Articulation point in lingustics: The place of articulation. In applied definition: The place of articulation of the letter where the sound stops hence, the letter is distinguished from other letters. Specific articulation point: It depends on certain part of the throat, the tongue or the lips. Approximate articulation point: It does not depend on certain part of the throat, the tongue or the lips, It has no specific point, but it finishes by stopping of exhale (air), It can be prolonged or shortened and three letters of madd are emitted from this articulation point. en.16: How do you know the articulation point of the letter? 1- We can pronounce the letter with sukoon. 2- We admit hamzatul Wasl before the sakin letter. 3- we pronounce the letter and where the sound stops, the articulation point is established. Types of articulation points: There are major articulation points (main) and specific articulation points (minor). Scholars have three opinions about the number of specific articulation points (minor) that fall under the major articulation points (main). 1- There are 17 articulation points: The school of thought is followed by Ibn Al_Gazari and also the majority of scholars as the following: (1) articulation point from Jawf, (3) articulation points from throat, (10) articulation points from tongue, (2) articulation points from lips and (1) articulation point from nasal cavity. 2- There are 16 articulation points: The school of thought is followed by Sibawayh and A'Shatby. They do not consider Jawf as articulation point. They believe that letters that are emitted from Jawf have the same articulation point of the identical letters in drawing, Alif madd is articulated from the same articulation point of hamzah (throat), waaw madd is articulated from the same articulation point of non _lengthening waaw (lips) and Yaa madd is articulated from the same articulation point of non_lengthening yaa (the middle of the tongue) 3- There are 14 articulation points: The school of thought is followed by Al_Faraa and Qutrub. they agree Sybawyh and his followers on disregarding 1 articulation point from Jawf. they add also that laam, raa and noon are emitted from the same articulation point.

To distinguish among letters that share the same articulation point, If these letters don't have different characteristics, they will be the same letter. If there is no isti'laa or itbaq (elevation or adhesion) with s'aad, it will be seen and with no jahr (appearence) with zaay, it will be seen. To beautify the pronunciation of the letter, Giving every letter its required characteristics makes the pronunciation more fluent, perfect and superior, whereas neglecting the characteristics makes the letters overlapped and similar or not clear in pronunciation. To know strong and weak letters, The letter that is characterized by strong qualities, is strong and the letter that is characterized by weak qualities is weak, The letter also may have both strong and weak qualities at the same time so, we judge upon it according to the majority of its characteristics. en.86: Science of stop and start is one of the most important researches in the recitation of the Qur'an, The reciter must collect what guides him to a proper stop and good start. Waqf (stop) Cutting off the sound at the end of the word for a period of time usually accompanied by taking breath with an intention of resuming recitation not abandoning it. Qat'(Cutting off) Interrupting recitation with an intention of ending it and then, doing another job like Ruku (Bowing down). Sakt (Slight pause) Cutting off the sound for a period of time less than the time of stop without taking breath with an intention of continuing recitation. Forced stop : what happens to the reciter during his recitation due to a necessity forced him to stop like shortness of breath, coughing or sneezing or other excuses that compel him to stop. Its rule: It is permissible to stop at any word until the compelling state passes. Tested stop : It is required of the reciter to stop at certain word for being examined and ensuring the quality (correctness) of his recitation. Its rule: It is permissible for education. Waiting stop : A stop only for whom combines all different ways of recitation to a Sheikh, He stops on a word and then, resumes the verse from its beginning until he reads it by all shapes. Its rule: Its is permissible on condition of not giving a corrupt meaning. Optional stopg : The reciter stops by his own choice with no compelling state, It is divided into: Waqf (Stop) ( Permissible Impermissible Complete stop Ugly stop Sufficient stop Good stop Comparison among waqf, qat' and sakt Types of stop

id.3: Pendahuluan Segala puji bagi Allah, Rabb semesta alam. Shalawat dan salam semoga senantiasa tercurah kepada Nabi kita Muhammad , beserta keluarga dan para sahabatnya. Amma ba’du: Ilmu tajwid, sebagaimana ilmu-ilmu lainnya yang berkaitan dengan Kitab Allah Ta’ala, telah mendapatkan perhatian yang istimewa. Banyak karya yang ditulis dalam bidang ini, dan berbagai metode telah digunakan untuk menyajikan serta menjelaskan topik- topiknya dengan beragam pendekatan. Saya ingin turut berkontribusi dengan sesuatu yang sederhana dalam bidang ini. Oleh karena itu, saya telah menyusun buku ini yang mengumpulkan kaidah-kaidah ilmu tajwid. Untuk mempermudah pemahaman kaidah-kaidah tersebut bagi pembaca, saya menggunakan metode berikut: - Ilustrasi gambar untuk menunjukkan organ-organ artikulasi (tempat keluarnya huruf). - Pewarnaan huruf berdasarkan hukum-hukum tajwid. - Diagram dan pohon konsep untuk membagi serta menjelaskan cabang-cabang hukum tajwid. - Menghindari pembahasan yang terlalu detail serta perbedaan pendapat di kalangan ulama. Selain berupaya menyajikan materi dengan cara yang mudah dipahami, saya juga berusaha agar buku ini dapat diakses oleh semua orang, baik yang dekat maupun yang jauh. Oleh karena itu, buku ini tersedia dalam format PDF yang dapat diunduh dalam bahasa Arab, Kurdi, dan Indonesia. Selain itu, saya membebaskan hak cetak dan penyebaran buku ini kepada siapa saja, dengan syarat tidak ada perubahan atau penghapusan dalam isinya. Sebelum mengakhiri, saya ingin menyampaikan bahwa semua definisi, catatan, serta informasi yang terdapat dalam buku ini diambil dari kitab-kitab tajwid yang sudah dikenal oleh para penuntut ilmu dalam bidang ini. Hanya saja, saya menyajikannya dengan gaya yang berbeda. Saya memohon kepada Allah agar menerima amalan ini dengan ikhlas karena-Nya, dan menjadikannya sebagai tambahan dalam timbangan amal kebaikan saya. Shalawat serta salam semoga senantiasa tercurah kepada Nabi kita Muhammad, beserta keluarga dan para sahabatnya. id.9: Ada 3 tingkatan (kecepatan) membaca al-Qur'an: Merupakan bacaan lambat dengan tingkat kemahiran dan ketelitian tertinggi, sangat cocok untuk pembelajaran. Merupakan bacaan cepat yang dilakukan oleh qari’ tanpa merusak huruf, makhrajnya, atau sifat-sifatnya. Dalam tingkatan hadr, seorang qari’ harus memperhatikan 2 hal: a- kecepatan membaca . b- kemahiran membaca tanpa mengabaikan aturan dan tidak merusaknya. Merupakan bacaan pertengahan antara tahqiq (lambat) dan hadr (cepat). Tartil tidak termasuk dalam tingkatan qira’ah, tetapi ia melekat pada tiga tingkatan diatas, jadi tartil adalah membaca dengan memahami dan mentadabburi disertai memberikan haq dan mustahaq huruf pada sifat dan makhrajnya. Karena sesungguhnya al-Qur’an diturunkan untuk diamalkan, difahami dan ditadabburi sebagaimana firman Allah: “Ini adalah sebuah kitab yang Kami turunkan kepadamu penuh dengan berkah supaya mereka memperhatikan ayat-ayatnya dan supaya mendapat pelajaran orang-orang yang mempunyai pikiran.” (Shad: 29) Tingkatan Membaca Al-Qur’an (Kecepatannya) 1 - Tahqiq (lambat) 2 - Hadr (cepat) 3 - Tadwir (pertengahan)

Jika qari' memilih untuk tidak mengucapkan basmallah, maka ada dua cara: Cara pertama: Qatha' (memutus): berhenti pada ist'adzah dan memutus ayat berikutnya.
